target.title: fix(zalouser): settle waitForExit when abort signal already fired
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where stopping a ZaloUser gateway account during or immediately after connection startup could leave channel shutdown waiting forever. The race occurs when the gateway stop signal is already aborted before the monitor registers its listener, or becomes aborted while startup allowlist/group resolution is in progress.

## Why This Change Was Made

`AbortSignal` does not replay an `abort` event to listeners registered after the signal has fired. The monitor now checks for shutdown before asynchronous startup work and rechecks after that work before creating the Zalo listener. The existing listener lifecycle remains local to listener startup; no extra lifecycle state is introduced.

The fix stays inside the ZaloUser plugin and adds no config, protocol, SDK, dependency, or compatibility surface.

## User Impact

ZaloUser stop and restart operations now settle promptly instead of hanging during fast gateway restarts or overlapping account lifecycle transitions. An aborted startup also cannot restore a Zalo listener session.

## Evidence

The dedicated lifecycle suite follows the production gateway boundary (`zalouserPlugin.gateway.startAccount` -> `monitorZalouserProvider`) and mocks only the outer Zalo SDK/network boundary. It proves:

- normal startup remains pending until abort, then invokes the listener's `stop` exactly once and settles;
- shutdown during the pending friends-resolution Promise completes without restoring `startZaloListener`;
- an already-aborted signal skips monitor preflight and listener startup;
- failure-path cleanup always aborts and settles test tasks, preventing leaked Promises or cross-test pollution.

Same-test A/B result:

| Revision | Result | Observable behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `origin/main@4e0cc187a2` | 1 passed, 2 failed | Calls `startZaloListener` after mid-preflight abort; calls `listZaloFriends` after pre-abort |
| PR head `6b1c1d291e` | 3 passed, 0 failed | Both invalid startup paths are skipped; normal abort/stop lifecycle still passes |

Focused validation on PR head:

```text
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       26 passed (26)
```

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalouser/src/channel.lifecycle.test.ts extensions/zalouser/src/monitor.group-gating.test.ts extensions/zalouser/src/monitor.account-scope.test.ts
```

`pnpm format` and `git diff --check` pass. The local changed-check could not acquire Blacksmith because the `blacksmith` executable is unavailable; the pushed head's standard GitHub lint/type/build gates are the authoritative replacement.

The remaining untested boundary is a configured Zalo account and live Zalo service. This deterministic gateway-level proof does not claim to be a live-account E2E; maintainers can either run the same stop/restart scenario with a configured account or explicitly accept the outer-boundary substitution.
